title: Ex Nihilo Right Click Pebble
description: This mod allow the player to obtain Ex Nihilo Sequentia's stone pebble by shift-right clicking on a grass or dirt block.
body:
This mod allow the player to obtain Ex Nihilo Sequentia's stone pebble by shift-right clicking on a grass or dirt block.

This mod is a reimplementation of the same mechanic present in Botania: Garden Of Glass.
